objective: Make a failed runtime deployment recover to the previous verified package, provider policy and worker image, rather than only restarting services.
evidence_required: Inspect the deployed updater and prove the failure path in an isolated harness before changing it.
acceptance: Inject install, image and startup failures; restore the exact prior verified runtime without losing jobs or exposing credentials. No live destructive failure injection.

objective: Recover unused but due provider circuits with small schema-validated real generation canaries, using existing shared capacity and allowance accounting.
evidence_required: Compare authenticated catalogue health with actual phase-model generation outcomes. Exclude operator cancellations and retired-model records.
acceptance: One bounded canary per due provider, no repeated quota probes before cooldown, no sibling-state loss and no manufactured healthy status.

objective: Turn repeated font, design-preview and invalid-output failures into versioned, tested, narrowly applicable repair strategies.
evidence_required: Use failing job evidence and inspect the current branch and main before proposing any edit.
acceptance: Add failure fixtures and regression tests. Never fake preview approval, delete failure history or reset unrelated jobs.

objective: Reliably distinguish application merges from factory maintenance, documentation, duplicates and unknown changes; measure CI wait and repair time.
evidence_required: Preserve known components in lightweight inventories and enrich only missing recent merge metadata with bounded GitHub calls.
acceptance: Report rolling application merges/hour, model time/merge and CI wait; show unknowns explicitly and test missing or stale metadata.

objective: Reduce head-of-line blocking between cheap merges, reviews and heavy verification without exceeding the shared host resource budget.
evidence_required: Measure queue and gate waits; reproduce starvation with deterministic scheduling tests.
acceptance: Demonstrate better completed application throughput under a replayed workload with equal or lower resource use; retain exact-head merge checks and exclusive heavy-build admission.

objective: Remove duplicated or unaffected verification while retaining meaningful changed-path coverage and full main integration tests.
evidence_required: Identify actual repeated test executions and prove a replacement's affected-path mapping with fixtures.
acceptance: No blanket test removal; preserve security, database, cross-workspace and review-mutated-head coverage. Measure saved CI and model minutes.

objective: Improve phase-specific model choice using current-model success, latency, quota and validated output evidence, with bounded exploration.
evidence_required: Replay historical failure fixtures and consult account model catalogues. Do not assume a newer model is available or better.
acceptance: Version routing changes, independently review them, compare outcomes and retain a known-good policy. Never bypass allowance accounting or spawn untracked model sessions.
